verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay is media-transport infrastructure: a relay server, protocol libraries, a CLI and an OBS plugin. A built-in AI assistant that takes delegated tasks is outside this product category, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships one. The SageOx transcription pipeline uses MoQ only as transport for an external consumer, so it is not a product-native assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
